mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mf_mail mail INNER JOIN mf_mail_account account ON account.id = mail.account_id AND account.user_id = mail.user_id WHERE mail.user_id = #{userId} AND mail.folder = 'inbox' AND mail.unread = TRUE AND account.enabled = TRUE AND account.password_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(account.password_ciphertext) != ''

SELECT remote.uid_validity AS uidValidity, remote.remote_uid AS uid, COALESCE(mail.body, '') AS body FROM mf_mail_remote remote INNER JOIN mf_mail mail ON mail.id = remote.mail_id AND mail.user_id = remote.user_id AND mail.account_id = remote.account_id WHERE remote.user_id = #{userId} AND remote.account_id = #{accountId} AND remote.remote_folder = 'INBOX' AND mail.body IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remote.uid_validity DESC, remote.remote_uid DESC LIMIT 200
